intro.title: A small farm with a simple promise
paragraphs: In the heart of Chettinad, we look after our cows the way families here always have – with patience, clean water, green fodder and plenty of open space.
We started Kamadhenu Dairy because we wanted our own children to drink milk we could trust. Today we share that same milk with families around us: nothing added, nothing taken away.

promise.title: Our promise to your family
promise.intro: Good milk doesn't need clever marketing. It needs healthy cows, clean hands and a short trip to your door.

nativeBreed.title: Native breed cows
nativeBreed.text: Our milk comes from native Indian cows, which naturally give A2 milk.

noPreservatives.title: No preservatives
noPreservatives.text: No preservatives, no thickeners, no added water. Just milk.

fresh.title: Farm-fresh within hours
fresh.text: Milked early in the morning, chilled, and on its way to you within hours.

glass.title: Glass bottle delivery
glass.text: Clean, reusable glass bottles keep milk tasting fresh and cut down on plastic.

purity.title: Purity
purity.text: What leaves our farm is exactly what our cows give – tested, chilled and sealed with care.

tradition.title: Tradition

quality.title: Quality
